TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Delhi Traffic Police has made special traffic arrangements in connection with the Centenary Year Celebration of Shri Ram College of Commerce, North Campus, Delhi University on 08.02.2026. Traffic movement will be affected around North Campus roads.

Time: 03:00 PM – 10:00 PM

📍 AFFECTED ROADS
-Chhatra Marg, University Marg, Sudhir Bose Marg
-Guru Teg Bahadur Marg & Mall Road stretch

📍 DIVERSION POINTS (On Need Basis)
-St. Stephens RL, Hindu College RL, Kranti Chowk
-Patel Chest & Mall Road connecting roads
-Except emergency vehicles

📍 PUBLIC ADVISORY
-Avoid affected roads and plan alternate routes
-Follow directions of traffic personnel on duty

📍 Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police official channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory

TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Special traffic arrangements will be in place for the inauguration of Electric DTC Buses at Ram Leela Ground on 08.02.2026. Traffic restrictions/diversions will apply in nearby areas for smooth conduct of the event.

Time: 09:00 AM – 02:00 PM

📍 LIKELY AFFECTED ROADS
-JLN Marg, Asaf Ali Road, Chaman Lal Marg
-R/A Kamla Market & nearby stretches

📍 DIVERSION (Need Basis)
-Heavy vehicles may be diverted from Delhi Gate, Minto Road & Ajmeri Gate side
-Traffic may be rerouted via ITO–DDU Marg–Minto Road
-Kamla Market side vehicles may be turned towards Minto Road

📍 PARKING & PUBLIC ADVISORY
-Parking allowed only at Mata Sundari College
-No roadside parking on notified roads, violators will be towed
-Visitors to New Delhi Railway Station should plan via ITO–DDU Marg

📍Stay updated through Delhi Police Traffic channels

#DPTrafficAdvisory
